reserveReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 26197399 (2026-10-15T10:44:59Z), totalBackingValue and recognizedBackingValue both equal 5541726221558535991407754 raw 18-decimal units. deployedPrincipal is 5042851815052535991407754, including continuously accrued receivables, with zero principal impairment. idleUSDC and physical canonical USDC balance both equal 498874406506 raw six-decimal units. Physical USDfr totalSupply is 5536330484442284742571821; controller totalUSDfr, including unissued accrued liabilities, equals 5541726221558535991407754. Weights use recognized backing, not physical token supply or contractual face. ClaimBridge totalOriginated=11; exhaustive facility(1..11) reads show all Active and nonrenewable. Ten renewable-energy facilities share one borrower identifier and mature on 2029-05-29; the digital-assets facility matures on 2027-09-21. The contractual maximum rounds up to 957 remaining days at the pinned timestamp. This ceiling is not WAM, cash realization timing, independent credit valuation or a permanent limit on future originations.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Pinned Ethereum recognizedBackingValue, deployedPrincipal, totalPrincipalImpairment, idleUSDC and canonical USDC balance at block 26197399; onchain accounting claim, not independently verified loan value
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Deployed credit book has onchain accounting and facility identifiers, but borrower identities, executed liens/segregation instruments, independently confirmed collateral and financial assurance remain unavailable. Idle USDC alone creates the tracked collateral dependency. The October 9 liquidity review found no whole-credit-book realization deadline: issuer operating limits bound direct USDfr redemption by idle USDC, while principal and PIK accrual enter NAV before cash arrives. The sUSDfr queue's 21-day minimum is a separate holder route, not a maximum liquidity horizon for this credit-book exposure; the timestamped research classification preserves that distinction.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Exact Ethereum contract custodies idle USDC. Credit collateral is described as assigned, lien-perfected and escrowed via attester facts, but executed deeds, escrow account holders, borrower identities and asset-wide legal safeguards are not public. Named onchain custody cannot establish a whole-book regulated institutional tier.
